name: issue_goodwill_credit
description: Station C, shared by C1 and C2. Support-agent tool: a goodwill credit to one of a customer's accounts, behind three deterministic rules (positive amount, at most $100, a reason given; Factor II held good). Calls the Support API with the support-agent key, which reaches only the fictional customers.

input.description: Issue a goodwill credit to one of a Dewy Bank customer's accounts, for a support agent. Use this when the support agent asks to credit, refund or compensate a customer. Identify the customer by email and the account by the name the customer sees, for example "Everyday Checking"; call look_up_customer_accounts first if you are not sure of the exact name. The amount is in US dollars; give a short reason. Returns a status (completed, refused or failed), a plain-language message to relay, and the customer, account and amount involved. If the status is refused or failed, no money was credited: explain the message instead of retrying with different values.
